q18.

The database driver interface is `store.Driver` (`store/driver.go:10`). Its three implementations, with entry files:

- `store/db/mysql/mysql.go` — `mysql.DB` (line 14)
- `store/db/postgres/postgres.go` — `postgres.DB` (line 16)
- `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go` — `sqlite.DB` (line 16)

`NewDBDriver` — `store/db/db.go` (line 14), which switches on `profile.Driver` (`"sqlite"` / `"mysql"` / `"postgres"`) to select the implementation at startup.
